tagline.zh: 先沖水再問問題；先核對左右再下刀
tagline.en: Irrigate before you ask; check the side before the knife

desc.zh: 裂隙燈前的一天：一個焊工的鏽環、一通工廠的電話、一台左右差點弄錯的白內障、一顆痛到吐的眼睛。視力是眼科的生命徵象。
desc.en: A day at the slit lamp: a welder's rust ring, a phone call from a factory, a cataract that nearly went in the wrong eye, an eye that hurts enough to vomit. Visual acuity is ophthalmology's vital sign.

desc.zh: 視力表、眼壓計、pH 試紙、生物測量。醫師看之前的每一個數字，都是你量的。
desc.en: The acuity chart, the tonometer, pH strips, biometry. Every number the doctor reads before looking was measured by you.

about.zh: 白袍口袋永遠裝滿螢光染色試紙。口頭禪：「視力是眼科的生命徵象。」
about.en: White-coat pockets always full of fluorescein strips. Catchphrase: 'Visual acuity is ophthalmology's vital sign.'

about.zh: 夜裡看了四隻紅眼睛，每一隻都先量了視力。
about.en: Saw four red eyes overnight and checked the acuity of every one first.

about.zh: 分流的第一關。她說「這個先看」，就先看。
about.en: The first line of triage. When she says 'this one first', it is first.

about.zh: 人工水晶體的度數她會唸兩次，左右眼唸三次。
about.en: Reads the lens power twice and the eye three times.

about.zh: 昨天磨鐵時「只有一下下」沒戴護目鏡。右眼異物感一整夜，流淚、怕光。
about.en: Took the goggles off 'just for a second' while grinding yesterday. A night of a gritty right eye, tearing and light sensitivity.

about.zh: 左眼白內障，下午開刀。他想重新看清楚孫女的臉。他的病歷夾很厚。
about.en: Left cataract, surgery this afternoon. Wants to see his granddaughter's face clearly again. His notes folder is thick.

about.zh: 傍晚右眼劇痛、頭痛、看燈有彩虹圈、吐了兩次。家人以為是偏頭痛。
about.en: Severe right eye pain this evening, headache, rainbow haloes round lights, vomited twice. The family thought it was a migraine.

about.zh: 只在電話裡出現。她打來的時候，有人的眼睛正在被沖水。
about.en: Only ever on the phone. When she calls, someone's eye is being irrigated.

plain.zh: 用視力表量出來的數字，每一隻眼睛分開量。任何眼睛的檢查都從這裡開始。
plain.en: The number read off the chart, each eye separately. Every eye examination starts here.

plain.zh: 眼科的顯微鏡：一道細光切過角膜與前房，看得到比髮絲還細的東西。
plain.en: Ophthalmology's microscope: a thin blade of light sliced through the cornea and front chamber, showing things finer than a hair.

plain.zh: 一滴橘黃色染劑，在藍光下角膜破皮的地方會發綠光。
plain.en: A drop of orange dye; under blue light any scratch on the cornea glows green.

plain.zh: 卡在眼睛表面透明層上的小東西，常見是磨鐵的金屬屑。
plain.en: A speck stuck on the clear front surface of the eye, often a metal fragment from grinding.

plain.zh: 鐵屑在角膜上幾小時就會留下一圈鏽。能安全移除就移除，不行就隔一兩天等它變軟。
plain.en: Within hours an iron fragment leaves a ring of rust in the cornea. Remove it if that can be done safely; otherwise wait a day or two for it to soften.

plain.zh: 把上眼皮翻過來看裡面。很多「找不到的異物」就藏在那裡。
plain.en: Turning the upper eyelid inside out to look underneath. Many 'missing' foreign bodies hide there.

plain.zh: 酸或鹼噴到眼睛。鹼最危險，會一直往裡面吃。第一個動作永遠是沖水，問問題是第二個。
plain.en: Acid or alkali in the eye. Alkali is the most dangerous because it keeps burning inwards. The first action is always irrigation; questions come second.

plain.zh: 碰一下結膜囊的試紙。沖到數字回到中性、幾分鐘後再測還是中性，才可以停。
plain.en: A strip touched to the inside of the lower lid. Irrigation stops only when the reading is neutral and stays neutral a few minutes later.

plain.zh: 眼球裡的壓力。太高會傷視神經；急性隅角閉鎖時會高到讓人頭痛、嘔吐。
plain.en: The pressure inside the eyeball. Too high damages the optic nerve; in acute angle closure it rises enough to cause headache and vomiting.

plain.zh: 眼內液體的出口忽然被虹膜堵住，眼壓飆高。劇痛、視力模糊、看燈有彩虹圈、噁心。是急症。
plain.en: The eye's fluid drain is suddenly blocked by the iris and the pressure soars. Severe pain, blurred vision, haloes round lights, nausea. An emergency.

plain.zh: 下刀前全隊停下來核對病人、左右眼、人工水晶體度數。眼科的左右，錯一次就是錯一隻眼。
plain.en: Before the knife the whole team stops to confirm patient, which eye and the lens power. In eye surgery the wrong side is the wrong eye.

plain.zh: 白內障手術中，在水晶體前囊上撕出一個圓圓的開口。要連續、要圓、大小要剛好。
plain.en: In cataract surgery, tearing a round opening in the front capsule of the lens. It must be continuous, circular and just the right size.

plain.zh: 壓迫或牽拉眼球時心跳忽然變慢。停止刺激，大多數馬上回來。
plain.en: Pressure or traction on the eye makes the heart suddenly slow. Stop the stimulus and most recover at once.

text.zh: 下巴放好、額頭靠緊。細光、寬光、藍光，三種光看三種東西。
text.en: Chin in the rest, forehead against the bar. Thin beam, wide beam, blue light: three lights for three kinds of thing.

text.zh: 輕輕碰角膜量眼壓。急性隅角閉鎖的那隻眼，數字會高到讓人倒吸一口氣。
text.en: Touches the cornea gently to read the pressure. In acute angle closure the number makes people draw breath.

text.zh: 把混濁的水晶體震碎吸出來的機器。腳踏板控制，設定依規範。
text.en: Breaks up the cloudy lens with ultrasound and sucks it out. Foot-pedal controlled; settings per protocol.

text.zh: 大量生理食鹽水、點滴管、開瞼器。沖洗要持續，翻開眼瞼沖到穹窿。
text.en: Plenty of saline, a giving set, a lid speculum. Irrigation is continuous, with the lids everted so it reaches the fornices.

text.zh: 方主治的口袋裡永遠有。沾濕、輕碰下眼瞼內側、藍光下看。
text.en: Always in Dr Fang's pocket. Wet it, touch the inside of the lower lid, look under blue light.

text.zh: 比芝麻還小的鐵屑，在裂隙燈下閃了一下。阿豪說要貼在護目鏡上提醒自己。
text.en: Smaller than a sesame seed, it glinted once under the slit lamp. Hao says he will stick it on his goggles as a reminder.

text.zh: 工廠那隻眼沖了很久之後，終於變成中性的那一張。
text.en: The one that finally read neutral after a long irrigation of the factory worker's eye.

text.zh: 化學性眼傷：不先量視力、不先問病史、不先找醫師。先沖水，沖著沖著再問。
text.en: Chemical injury: no acuity first, no history first, no waiting for the doctor. Irrigate first and ask while the water runs.

text.zh: 同意書、病歷、生物測量、病人自己說、額頭的標記。五個來源不一致，就停下來，一個都不能跳過。
text.en: Consent, notes, biometry, the patient's own words, the mark on the forehead. If any of the five disagree, stop; none may be skipped.

note.zh: 交班：焊工、白內障、急診會打來
note.en: Handover: a welder, a cataract, and the ER will call

lines.zh: 早。門診第一個阿豪，焊工，右眼異物感一整夜。下午開刀房林阿公左眼白內障。
lines.en: Morning. First in clinic is Hao, a welder, gritty right eye all night. This afternoon in theatre, Grandpa Lin's left cataract.

lines.zh: 夜裡四隻紅眼睛，都沒事。急診說傍晚可能會有東西送來。
lines.en: Four red eyes overnight, all fine. The ER says something may come in towards evening.

lines.zh: 阿豪的視力量了嗎？
lines.en: Has Hao's acuity been done?

lines.zh: 怡萱會先量。方主治說：視力是眼科的生命徵象。
lines.en: Yi-hsuan will do it first. Dr Fang says acuity is ophthalmology's vital sign.

lines.zh: 白板：08:00 門診（阿豪）。14:00 左眼白內障（林阿公）。急診：待命。
lines.en: Whiteboard: 08:00 clinic (Hao). 14:00 left cataract (Grandpa Lin). ER: on standby.

lines.zh: 早。紅眼睛走進來，先問哪四個問題？
lines.en: Morning. A red eye walks in: what four questions first?

lines.zh: 視力有沒有掉、痛不痛、怕不怕光、有沒有戴隱形眼鏡或受傷。
lines.en: Has the vision dropped, does it hurt, is it light-sensitive, contact lenses or injury.

lines.zh: 四個都「有」的，就不是結膜炎。阿豪是焊工，你第五個問題？
lines.en: Four yeses and it is not conjunctivitis. Hao is a welder; your fifth question?

lines.zh: 當時有沒有敲擊金屬——有沒有可能是高速飛進去的穿透傷。
lines.en: Was he hammering metal: could it be a high-speed penetrating injury.

lines.zh: 對。去看他。口袋裡有試紙嗎？
lines.en: Right. Go and see him. Strips in your pocket?

note.zh: 阿豪：異物取出，鏽環有計畫
note.en: Hao: fragment out, rust ring planned

lines.zh: 醫師，昨天磨鐵，護目鏡拿下來只有一下下，右眼就一直有東西。
lines.en: Doctor, I was grinding yesterday, took the goggles off just for a second, and the right eye's felt gritty ever since.

lines.zh: 磨的，不是敲的？有沒有用鐵鎚打金屬？
lines.en: Grinding, not hammering? Any hammering metal on metal?

lines.zh: 沒有敲。就磨。
lines.en: No hammering. Just grinding.

lines.zh: 好。磨鐵的屑通常卡在表面。敲出來的碎片才會飛進眼球裡。先量視力。
lines.en: Good. Grinding sparks usually sit on the surface; hammered chips can fly into the eye. Acuity first.

lines.zh: 阿豪，遮左眼，唸最下面看得到的那行。右眼比左眼差一點，正常，眼睛一直在流淚。
lines.en: Hao, cover the left eye and read the lowest line you can. Right slightly worse than left; expected, the eye is watering.

lines.zh: 麻醉眼藥依醫囑點一滴，等一下就不那麼痛，醫師才檢查得了。
lines.en: One anaesthetic drop per protocol; in a moment it will hurt less and the doctor can examine you.

lines.zh: ……哇，不痛了。可以回去上班了嗎？
lines.en: ...wow, that's gone. Can I go back to work?

lines.zh: 這瓶不能帶走，也不能靠它上班。等醫師。
lines.en: You don't take that bottle home, and you don't work on it. Wait for the doctor.

lines.zh: 下巴放好。細光先切角膜，找異物與深度。然後染色，藍光。
lines.en: Chin in. Thin beam through the cornea first for the fragment and its depth. Then stain, blue light.

lines.zh: 角膜中央偏下一個金屬屑，表淺，周圍有一圈鏽環。染色：異物周圍一小片上皮缺損。前房乾淨。
lines.en: A corneal foreign body just below the centre, superficial, a rust ring around it. Staining: a small epithelial defect around it. Anterior chamber quiet.

lines.zh: 有沒有漏水？
lines.en: Any leak?

lines.zh: 染劑沒有被沖開，沒有穿透的跡象。
lines.en: The dye isn't being washed away; no sign of penetration.

lines.zh: 找到一個就滿足了嗎？
lines.en: Satisfied with finding one?

lines.zh: 不。翻轉眼瞼。阿豪，往下看，別閉眼。
lines.en: No. Lid eversion. Hao, look down, don't squeeze.

lines.zh: 上眼瞼翻過來，結膜上還黏著第二顆更小的屑。
lines.en: The upper lid flips over: a second, smaller speck clings to the conjunctiva.

lines.zh: 「只有一下下」通常不只一顆。
lines.en: 'Just for a second' is rarely just one speck.

guide.zh: 移除異物與鏽環：你的計畫
guide.en: Removing the fragment and the rust ring: your plan

lines.zh: 眼瞼那顆棉棒就下來了。角膜那顆取出來，鏽環呢？
lines.en: The lid speck came off with a cotton bud. The corneal one is out; what about the rust ring?

q.zh: 角膜異物取出後留下鏽環，怎麼做？
q.en: A rust ring remains after removing the corneal fragment. What do you do?

options.zh: 能安全移除就移除，否則一兩天後回診再處理
options.en: Remove it if safe; otherwise review in a day or two

why.zh: 對。鏽環放幾天會變軟、浮起來。中央角膜不要硬刮，刮深了會留疤。
why.en: Right. In a day or two the rust softens and lifts. Never dig hard in the central cornea; a deep scrape scars.

options.zh: 用針頭刮到完全乾淨為止
options.en: Scrape with the needle until it is completely clean

why.zh: 中央角膜刮太深會留下永久的疤，就在他看東西的正中間。
why.en: Dig too deep in the central cornea and you leave a permanent scar right where he looks through.

options.en: The rust ring doesn't matter; leave it

why.zh: 留著的鏽會延遲癒合、持續發炎。要有計畫，不是不管。
why.en: Rust left behind delays healing and keeps the eye inflamed. It needs a plan, not neglect.

post.zh: 鏽環邊緣鬆了，取出大部分。殘餘的後天回診。抗生素藥膏依醫囑，不包眼。
post.en: The ring's edge lifted and most of it is out. The rest at review the day after tomorrow. Antibiotic ointment per protocol, no patch.

post.zh: 這顆可以給我嗎？我要貼在護目鏡上。
post.en: Can I have the speck? I'm sticking it on my goggles.

lines.zh: 紀錄：視力、異物位置與深度、前房、兩顆異物、鏽環殘餘、無穿透跡象、破傷風依醫囑、回診日期。
lines.en: Note: acuity, fragment site and depth, anterior chamber, two fragments, residual rust, no sign of penetration, tetanus per protocol, review date.

lines.zh: 衛教最重要的一句？
lines.en: The most important line of advice?

lines.zh: 護目鏡不是「只有一下下」可以拿下來的東西。還有，麻醉眼藥不能帶走。
lines.en: Goggles are not something you take off 'just for a second'. And the anaesthetic drops don't go home with him.

note.zh: 化學性眼傷：沖到中性才停

sub.zh: 員工被鹼性清潔劑噴到左眼，正在沖水
sub.en: A worker splashed alkaline cleaner in the left eye; irrigating now

lines.zh: 眼科嗎？員工左眼被鹼性清潔劑噴到，我已經在沖水了。要先送過去還是繼續沖？
lines.en: Ophthalmology? A worker got alkaline cleaner in the left eye; I'm irrigating now. Do I send him in or keep going?

lines.zh: 繼續沖，邊沖邊送。不要停下來量視力、不要先找醫師。翻開眼瞼沖，到了我們接手。
lines.en: Keep irrigating and transport while you do. Don't stop for acuity, don't wait for a doctor. Evert the lids and flush; we take over when you arrive.

lines.zh: 他說很痛、想揉。
lines.en: He says it hurts and wants to rub.

lines.zh: 不能揉。沖水就是止痛。
lines.en: No rubbing. The water is the painkiller.

q.zh: 化學性眼傷到院後的正確順序
q.en: The correct order on arrival with a chemical eye injury

steps.zh: 立刻繼續沖洗，不先問診
steps.en: Continue irrigation at once; no history first

steps.zh: 麻醉眼藥依醫囑，放開瞼器
steps.en: Anaesthetic drops per protocol, lid speculum

steps.zh: 翻轉眼瞼、清除殘留顆粒
steps.en: Evert the lids, remove any particles

steps.zh: 測 pH，不中性就繼續沖
steps.en: Check pH; if not neutral, keep flushing

steps.zh: 幾分鐘後再測，仍中性才停
steps.en: Recheck minutes later; stop only if still neutral

steps.zh: 最後才量視力、裂隙燈分級
steps.en: Only then acuity and slit-lamp grading

lines.zh: 試紙輕碰下眼瞼內側。還偏鹼，繼續沖。再一袋。
lines.en: Strip to the inside of the lower lid. Still alkaline; keep flushing. Another bag.

lines.zh: 二十分鐘後，試紙終於是中性。五分鐘後再測，還是中性。
lines.en: Twenty minutes later the strip finally reads neutral. Five minutes on, still neutral.

lines.zh: 可以停了。現在才輪到視力和裂隙燈。
lines.en: Now we can stop. Only now the acuity and the slit lamp.

lines.zh: 沖乾淨了。分級看什麼？
lines.en: Irrigated clean. What does the grading look at?

lines.zh: 角膜混濁的程度，和角膜緣缺血有幾個鐘點。缺血越多，預後越差。
lines.en: How hazy the cornea is, and how many clock-hours of the limbus are ischaemic. More ischaemia, worse prognosis.

lines.zh: 這隻呢？
lines.en: And this one?

lines.zh: 角膜輕度混濁、角膜緣沒有明顯缺血。算好的那一端。工廠護理師沖得早，救了這隻眼。
lines.en: Mild corneal haze, no obvious limbal ischaemia. The good end of the scale. The factory nurse irrigated early and saved this eye.

note.zh: 眼眶骨折 CT：看肌肉有沒有卡住
note.en: Orbital fracture CT: is a muscle trapped

guide.zh: 和方主治看急診的眼眶 CT
guide.en: Review the ER's orbital CT with Dr Fang

lines.zh: 急診會診：年輕人被打到左眼，複視、往上看不上去。CT 你報。
lines.en: ER consult: a young man punched in the left eye, double vision, cannot look up. You read the CT.

lines.zh: 先看眼眶底和內側壁，再看肌肉有沒有掉進去。
lines.en: Orbital floor and medial wall first, then whether a muscle has dropped into the gap.

question.zh: 眼眶爆裂性骨折的 CT 要確認什麼？
question.en: What must the CT confirm in an orbital blow-out fracture?

answer.zh: 眼眶底或內側壁的骨折、下直肌或內直肌有沒有嵌頓、眼球位置與有無眼球破裂、眶內氣體、視神經管是否完整。
answer.en: A floor or medial wall fracture, whether the inferior or medial rectus is trapped, globe position and any rupture, air in the orbit, and an intact optic canal.

post.zh: 下直肌嵌頓，加上他往上看會噁心、心跳慢。這是眼心反射，要早點修。告訴整形外科。去吃飯。
post.en: Inferior rectus entrapped, and he feels sick with a slow pulse when he looks up: the oculocardiac reflex. Early repair. Tell plastics. Go and eat.

post.zh: 方主治從口袋掏出一張螢光試紙當書籤，夾進病歷。
post.en: Dr Fang pulls a fluorescein strip from her pocket to use as a bookmark in the notes.

note.zh: 林阿公的左眼：差點弄錯的左右
note.en: Grandpa Lin's left eye: the side that was nearly wrong

guide.en: Confirm which eye with Grandpa Lin

lines.zh: 醫師，左眼。看孫女的臉霧霧的那隻。
lines.en: Doctor, the left eye. The one that makes my granddaughter's face foggy.

lines.zh: 姓名、生日說一次。同意書寫左眼，生物測量是左眼。額頭的標記……
lines.en: Name and birthday once for me. Consent says left, biometry says left. The mark on the forehead...

lines.zh: 標記畫在右邊眉毛上方。
lines.en: The mark is above the right eyebrow.

lines.zh: 早上一個年輕人畫的，我沒看。
lines.en: A young man drew it this morning; I didn't look.

guide.zh: 時間暫停：標記與同意書不一致
guide.en: Time-out: the mark and the consent disagree

lines.zh: 時間暫停。林阿公，白內障手術——同意書左眼，標記在右邊。
lines.en: Time-out. Grandpa Lin, cataract surgery: consent left eye, mark on the right.

lines.zh: 你怎麼做？
lines.en: What do you do?

q.zh: 時間暫停時發現標記與同意書的左右不一致，怎麼辦？
q.en: At the time-out the side mark and the consent disagree. What do you do?

options.zh: 停下來，五個來源全部重新核對，確認後重新標記
options.en: Stop, recheck all five sources, re-mark only once they agree

why.zh: 對。同意書、病歷、生物測量、病人本人、標記。全部一致才繼續，一個都不能跳過。
why.en: Right. Consent, notes, biometry, the patient's own words, the mark. All five agree or nothing proceeds; none is skipped.

options.zh: 標記是早上畫的，相信標記
options.en: The mark was drawn this morning; trust the mark

why.zh: 標記是人畫的，人會畫錯。這就是我們今天差一點開錯的那隻眼。
why.en: A mark is drawn by a person, and people err. That is the eye we nearly operated on today.

options.zh: 同意書一定對，直接開左眼
options.en: The consent must be right; proceed on the left

why.zh: 就算最後結論是左眼，不一致的時候跳過核對，就是在練習開錯眼。
why.en: Even if the answer turns out to be left, skipping the check when sources disagree is practising for the wrong eye.

post.zh: 同意書左、病歷左、生物測量左、阿公說左、裂隙燈看白內障在左。標記擦掉，重畫左邊。
post.en: Consent left, notes left, biometry left, Grandpa says left, slit lamp shows the cataract on the left. Mark erased and redrawn on the left.

post.zh: 左眼的度數，唸兩次：一致。

guide.zh: 核對生物測量與人工水晶體

lines.zh: 生物測量：左眼軸長與角膜曲率，算出來的度數和盒子上的一樣。左眼、左眼、左眼。
lines.en: Biometry: left axial length and keratometry; the calculated power matches the box. Left, left, left.

lines.zh: 今天那個標記，提醒我們為什麼要唸三次。
lines.en: Today's mark is the reason we read it three times.

lines.zh: 顯微鏡下。撕囊要連續、要圓、大小蓋住人工水晶體邊緣一點點。
lines.en: Under the microscope. The capsulorhexis must be continuous, round, and just overlap the lens edge.

lines.zh: 一片前囊在染劑下像一片藍色的花瓣，慢慢被撕成一個圓。
lines.en: A flap of capsule, blue under the dye, is drawn slowly round into a circle.

lines.zh: 器械壓在眼球上的瞬間，監視器的嗶聲拉長了。心跳在往下掉。
lines.en: As an instrument presses on the globe the monitor's beeps stretch out. The heart rate is falling.

lines.zh: 眼心反射。你的第一個動作？
lines.en: Oculocardiac reflex. Your first move?

options.zh: 停止刺激、放鬆壓迫、通知麻醉、必要時依醫囑
options.en: Stop the stimulus, release the pressure, tell anaesthesia, drugs per protocol if needed

why.zh: 對。反射的開關在眼球上。手放開，大多數幾秒內回來。
why.en: Right. The reflex's switch is on the eye. Let go, and most recover within seconds.

why.zh: 繼續壓著，心跳可以慢到停。先放手。
why.en: Keep pressing and the heart can slow to a stop. Hands off first.

options.en: Press harder so the reflex adapts

why.zh: 沒有這種適應。這是反射，不是訓練。
why.en: There is no such adaptation. It is a reflex, not a workout.

post.zh: 放手。幾秒鐘，嗶聲回到原來的節奏。
post.en: Hands off. Within seconds the beeps return to their rhythm.

post.zh: 人工水晶體進去了，居中。阿公，明天你會看到孫女。
post.en: Lens in and centred. Grandpa, tomorrow you'll see your granddaughter.

name.en: ER: an eye that hurts enough to vomit

note.zh: 陳阿姨：急性隅角閉鎖，眼壓降下來了
note.en: Mrs Chen: acute angle closure, pressure brought down

sub.zh: 62 歲女性，右眼劇痛、頭痛、嘔吐、看燈有彩虹圈
sub.en: Woman of 62: severe right eye pain, headache, vomiting, haloes round lights

guide.zh: 接電話，去急診看陳阿姨
guide.en: Take the call and see Mrs Chen in the ER

lines.zh: 醫師，急診那位來了：右眼痛到吐、頭痛、看燈有彩虹圈，角膜霧霧的，瞳孔半開不動。家人以為是偏頭痛。
lines.en: Doctor, the ER patient is here: right eye pain with vomiting, headache, haloes, hazy cornea, pupil mid-dilated and fixed. The family thought it was a migraine.

lines.zh: 急性隅角閉鎖，先當它是。視力、眼壓，馬上。
lines.en: Acute angle closure until proven otherwise. Acuity and pressure, now.

lines.zh: 阿姨，先看視力表，右眼。只看得到最大的字。麻醉眼藥依醫囑一滴，量眼壓，會輕輕碰一下。
lines.en: Mrs Chen, the chart first, right eye. Only the biggest letter. One anaesthetic drop per protocol, then the pressure; a gentle touch.

lines.zh: 右眼的眼壓高得讓人倒吸一口氣。左眼正常。
lines.en: The right eye's pressure makes you draw breath. The left is normal.

lines.zh: 醫師……是中風嗎？
lines.en: Doctor... is it a stroke?

lines.zh: 不是中風，是眼壓。醫師馬上來，今天就會把它降下來。
lines.en: Not a stroke; it's the pressure in the eye. The doctor is coming, and it comes down today.

guide.zh: 降壓原則：和方主治決定
guide.en: Principles of lowering the pressure: decide with Dr Fang

lines.zh: 右眼視力只剩手動，眼壓極高，角膜水腫，瞳孔半開固定，前房淺。急性隅角閉鎖。
lines.en: Right eye down to hand movements, pressure extremely high, corneal oedema, mid-dilated fixed pupil, shallow chamber. Acute angle closure.

lines.zh: 降壓的原則？不要給我劑量。
lines.en: Principles of lowering it? No doses, please.

lines.zh: 依醫囑多管齊下：減少房水生成、把房水抽出來、縮瞳把隅角打開。平躺，止吐，一小時後再量眼壓。
lines.en: Several routes at once per protocol: reduce fluid production, draw fluid out, constrict the pupil to open the angle. Lie flat, antiemetic, re-measure in an hour.

lines.zh: 角膜清了之後？
lines.en: And once the cornea clears?

lines.zh: 雷射虹膜切開，兩隻眼都要做。另一隻眼是下一個等著發作的。
lines.en: Laser iridotomy, both eyes. The other eye is the next attack waiting to happen.

post.zh: 一小時後：眼壓往下，角膜開始變清，陳阿姨不吐了，看得到你的手指頭了。
post.en: An hour later: pressure falling, cornea clearing, Mrs Chen no longer vomiting, and she can count your fingers.

note.zh: 交給夜班；師傅的三件事
note.en: Handed to the night team; the mentor's three things

guide.en: Hand over to the night team

lines.zh: 阿豪異物取出、鏽環後天回診。工廠那隻眼沖到中性。林阿公左眼白內障順利，標記寫了異常事件。陳阿姨眼壓降了，明早雷射。
lines.en: Hao: fragment out, rust review in two days. The factory eye: neutral pH. Grandpa Lin: left cataract done, the mark reported as an incident. Mrs Chen: pressure down, laser tomorrow.

lines.zh: 陳阿姨今晚？
lines.en: Mrs Chen tonight?

lines.zh: 眼壓每幾小時量、平躺、止吐，痛回來就打給我。
lines.en: Pressure every few hours, flat, antiemetic, and call me if the pain comes back.

lines.zh: 收到。那個標記，你停下來了。
lines.en: Received. That mark: you stopped.

guide.en: Dr Fang brings up the mark

lines.zh: 時間暫停的時候，你本來想相信標記。
lines.en: At the time-out you first wanted to trust the mark.

lines.zh: 對。佩君說「不一致就停」。
lines.en: I did. Pei-chun said 'disagreement means stop'.

lines.zh: 刷手護理師今天救了一隻眼。明天你會是那個說「停」的人。
lines.en: The scrub nurse saved an eye today. Tomorrow you will be the one who says 'stop'.

lines.zh: 今天三件事。阿豪的眼瞼，你翻了。工廠那通電話，你沒有讓沖水停下來。
lines.en: Three things today. Hao's lid: you everted it. The factory call: you did not let the water stop.

lines.zh: 陳阿姨，你第一句就是「視力、眼壓」。
lines.en: Mrs Chen: your first words were 'acuity, pressure'.

lines.zh: 您口袋裡的試紙今天用了幾張？
lines.en: How many strips from your pocket today?

lines.zh: 五張，一張當書籤。去吃飯。
lines.en: Five, one as a bookmark. Go and eat.

note.zh: 夜裡一隻戴隱形眼鏡的紅眼睛，今晚就看
note.en: A contact-lens red eye at night, seen tonight

sub.zh: 23 歲，戴隱形眼鏡睡覺，左眼痛、怕光、視力模糊
sub.en: Woman of 23 who sleeps in contact lenses: painful left eye, light-sensitive, blurred

lines.zh: 醫師，急診：23 歲，戴隱形眼鏡睡覺，左眼痛、怕光、視力變差。急診問可不可以明早門診。
lines.en: Doctor, ER: 23, sleeps in her contact lenses, painful left eye, photophobic, vision down. The ER asks if morning clinic is fine.

lines.zh: 隱形眼鏡加痛加視力掉——四問全中。這不是明天的事。
lines.en: Contact lens plus pain plus a drop in vision: all four questions positive. This is not tomorrow's problem.

q.zh: 戴隱形眼鏡者夜裡紅眼、痛、視力下降，怎麼做？
q.en: A contact lens wearer with a painful red eye and reduced vision at night. What do you do?

options.zh: 今晚看、停戴、鏡片與盒子一起帶來培養
options.en: See her tonight, lenses out, bring lenses and case for culture

why.zh: 對。隱形眼鏡的角膜潰瘍一夜之間可以變大。刮片培養在抗生素之前。
why.en: Right. A contact-lens corneal ulcer can grow overnight. Scrape and culture before antibiotics.

options.en: Morning clinic; just stop wearing them

why.zh: 一夜可以讓潰瘍從邊緣走到中央。今晚看。
why.en: One night can move an ulcer from the edge to the centre. Tonight.

why.zh: 沒看過就給類固醇，感染性潰瘍會爆開。先看、先培養。
why.en: Steroids on an unseen eye make an infective ulcer explode. Look first, culture first.

guide.en: Her cornea under the slit lamp

lines.zh: 視力先量：左眼掉了兩行。裂隙燈：角膜中央偏下一個白色浸潤，染色有缺損，前房有細胞。
lines.en: Acuity first: left eye down two lines. Slit lamp: a white infiltrate below the central cornea, staining defect, cells in the anterior chamber.

lines.zh: 角膜潰瘍。刮片培養，鏡片盒也送。抗生素依醫囑開始，明早方主治再看。隱形眼鏡，先停到好為止。
lines.en: Corneal ulcer. Scrape for culture, lens case too. Antibiotics per protocol started; Dr Fang reviews in the morning. No lenses until it has healed.

lines.zh: 她問：「那我明天怎麼看得到？」你把她的眼鏡從包包裡找出來。
lines.en: She asks: 'Then how do I see tomorrow?' You find her glasses in her bag.

sub.en: 'Mrs Chen's pressure is steady. 07:30 tomorrow; bring strips.'

lines.zh: 一顆鐵屑、一張中性的試紙、一個擦掉重畫的標記、一隻降下來的眼壓、一個潰瘍。每一隻眼睛都先量了視力。
lines.en: One iron speck, one neutral strip, one mark erased and redrawn, one pressure brought down, one ulcer. Every eye had its acuity checked first.

lines.zh: 值班結束。裂隙燈的燈關了，門診桌上留著一張沒用完的螢光試紙。
lines.en: End of shift. The slit lamp goes dark; one unused fluorescein strip lies on the clinic desk.

sub.zh: 視力是眼科的生命徵象
sub.en: Visual acuity is ophthalmology's vital sign
